basic_info.description: Great for a primary home or rental! Located right in the heart of bustling & ever popular Hayes Valley!  Unit 605 is an oversized + bright 1BD/1BA condo on the 6th floor of a 50 unit building. Open floor plan, wood flooring in main living area, in-unit laundry, and ample closet space (incl. walk-in closet). Building amenities: secure parking, gym, concierge, large storage unit and beautiful shared roof deck with BBQ and seating. Easy & convenient access to downtown, freeways, shopping/dining on Hayes Street, Performing Arts District, and nearby Patricia's Green! 100 Transit Score / 98 Walkscore.
